Patch src/cli/projectConfig.ts (its current text follows) and return it WHOLE. Two changes only. (1) loadConfig: a text whose every line (split on "\n"), trimmed, is "" or starts with "#" is treated as blank and gives the default config, as null and a blank text do; any other text goes to parseDocument as today. (2) readProjectConfig: the fs.statSync and fs.readFileSync calls go inside one try; a thrown value e gives {ok: false, result: {code: 2, document: errorDocument(2, "DeckError", "morph.config.yaml cannot be read: " + reason)}} where reason is e.code when e is an object whose code is a string, else String(e); the message starts with CONFIG_FILE. Everything else (validateConfig, the tables, the messages of invalid configs, the exports, the imports) stays exactly as it is; no `any` (narrow the caught unknown). Write no test file: a probe tests you and a judge writes the example tests.

## Function Load Config

morph.config.yaml into a whole Project Config, or every problem it has.

Behaviour: src/cli/projectConfig.ts. CONFIG_FILE = "morph.config.yaml". DEFAULT_CONFIG = {version: 1, scout: DEFAULT_SCOUT_SETTINGS (Scout Command's)}. validateConfig(doc: unknown) → {ok: true, config} | {ok: false, problems: string[]}. Not a plain object → problems ["(root): config must be an object"]. Every object is checked against its key table — (root): version, scout; scout: grepSkip, budgets, caps, seed; scout.budgets: calls, reads, chars, rounds, deadlineSeconds; scout.caps: readLines, readChars, grepHits, grepLineChars, listEntries; scout.seed: files, chars — first its unknown keys in the object's order ("<path>: unknown key '<k>' (known: <the table ", "-joined>)", <path> "(root)" at the top, else the dotted path), then its keys in table order. version must be 1 ("version: must be 1"); scout, scout.budgets, scout.caps, scout.seed objects ("<path>: must be an object"); scout.grepSkip a list ("scout.grepSkip: must be a list") of non-empty strings ("scout.grepSkip[<j>]: must be a non-empty string"); every other leaf a number that is a positive integer ("<path>: must be a positive integer"). Every key is optional: config = DEFAULT_CONFIG with each given value in place of its default (grepSkip as a whole list, a budget, cap or seed key alone), keys always in DEFAULT_CONFIG's order. Any problem → {ok: false, problems} in document order. loadConfig(text: string | null, name = CONFIG_FILE): null, or a text that is blank after trim → {ok: true, config: DEFAULT_CONFIG}; else contour's Parse Document(text, name) error → {ok: false, problems: [its error]}; else validateConfig(doc); a text whose every line is blank or a comment (first non-blank char "#") is blank. readProjectConfig(root) → {ok: true, config} | {ok: false, result}: path.join(root, CONFIG_FILE) a regular file → loadConfig(its UTF-8 text), else loadConfig(null); the stat or the read throwing e → result {code 2, document errorDocument(2, "DeckError", "morph.config.yaml cannot be read: " + e.code)} (String(e) when e has no string code); problems → result {code 2, document errorDocument(2, "DeckError", "morph.config.yaml is not a valid config (<n> problem|problems): " + the problems "; "-joined)} (Emit Document's shape: {error: {code, kind, message}}). Nothing is written.

Steps:
- uses: scout-session
- uses: contour
- produces: Project Config

1. given loadConfig(null); loadConfig(" \n"); loadConfig("version: 1\n"); validateConfig({}); when called; then each {ok: true, config: DEFAULT_CONFIG}; DEFAULT_CONFIG = {version: 1, scout: {grepSkip: [".morph", "decks"], budgets: {calls: 30, reads: 12, chars: 120000, rounds: 40, deadlineSeconds: 1800}, caps: {readLines: 400, readChars: 12000, grepHits: 200, grepLineChars: 300, listEntries: 300}, seed: {files: 6, chars: 8000}}}: budgets = DEFAULT_BUDGETS with deadlineSeconds = deadlineMs / 1000, caps = DEFAULT_TOOL_CAPS without grepSkip, grepSkip = DEFAULT_TOOL_CAPS.grepSkip, seed = {SEED_FILES, SEED_CHARS}
2. given the text "scout:\n seed: {files: 3}\n budgets: {deadlineSeconds: 600, calls: 10}\n grepSkip: [.morph/, decks/, docs/TASK_]\n"; when loadConfig; then {ok: true, config: {version: 1, scout: {grepSkip: [".morph/", "decks/", "docs/TASK_"], budgets: {calls: 10, reads: 12, chars: 120000, rounds: 40, deadlineSeconds: 600}, caps: DEFAULT_CONFIG.scout.caps, seed: {files: 3, chars: 8000}}}}, JSON.stringify of it equal to that of the literal (keys in DEFAULT_CONFIG's order)
3. given the text "version: 2\nscuot: 1\nscout:\n caps: []\n budgets: {calls: \"30\", reads: 0, call: 1}\n grepSkip: [\"\", 3]\n"; validateConfig([]); validateConfig({scout: null}); validateConfig({scout: {grepSkip: "decks", seed: {chars: 1.5}}}); loadConfig("a: [\n"); loadConfig("- 1\n"); when loadConfig, validateConfig; then {ok: false, problems: ["(root): unknown key 'scuot' (known: version, scout)", "version: must be 1", "scout.grepSkip[0]: must be a non-empty string", "scout.grepSkip[1]: must be a non-empty string", "scout.budgets: unknown key 'call' (known: calls, reads, chars, rounds, deadlineSeconds)", "scout.budgets.calls: must be a positive integer", "scout.budgets.reads: must be a positive integer", "scout.caps: must be an object"]}; ["(root): config must be an object"]; ["scout: must be an object"]; ["scout.grepSkip: must be a list", "scout.seed.chars: must be a positive integer"]; one problem starting "cannot parse morph.config.yaml: "; ["morph.config.yaml is not a mapping at the top level"]
4. given a tmpRoot r: no morph.config.yaml; then morph.config.yaml "scout:\n grepSkip: [docs/TASK_]\n"; then "scout: {budgets: {calls: x}, cap: 1}\n"; then a directory r2 holding a directory named morph.config.yaml, and r2's parent holding an invalid morph.config.yaml; when readProjectConfig; then {ok: true, config: DEFAULT_CONFIG}; {ok: true, config} with scout.grepSkip ["docs/TASK_"], the rest DEFAULT_CONFIG; {ok: false, result: {code: 2, document: {error: {code: 2, kind: "DeckError", message: "morph.config.yaml is not a valid config (2 problems): scout: unknown key 'cap' (known: grepSkip, budgets, caps, seed); scout.budgets.calls: must be a positive integer"}}}}; {ok: true, config: DEFAULT_CONFIG} (not a regular file; the parent is never read)
5. given loadConfig("# all commented out\n# scout:\n# grepSkip: []\n"); loadConfig("\n # x\n\n"); loadConfig("# c\nversion: 2\n"); when loadConfig; then {ok: true, config: DEFAULT_CONFIG} twice; {ok: false, problems: ["version: must be 1"]}

Data Project Config: What Load Config gives; every key present.
Schema:
{ version: 1, scout: { grepSkip: string[], budgets: { calls, reads, chars, rounds, deadlineSeconds: number }, caps: { readLines, readChars, grepHits, grepLineChars, listEntries: number }, seed: { files, chars: number } } }

## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Strict TypeScript: tsconfig strict, ESM, no `any`; every module compiles with tsc --noEmit.
- One Document Out: Every command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout and nothing else; the human log goes to stderr.
- Deterministic Core: cards and compiler give byte-identical results for the same inputs: no clock, no randomness, no environment reads. acceptance is bound only in its pure parts (Snapshot Targets, Build Attempt Diff): Run Acceptance spawns a shell and its only timer is the child's timeout; env and the timeout are parameters, never process.env (06.10, P3). processor reads the environment only in Read Registry; Assemble Request, Read Response, Stub Answer, Assemble Batch and Read Batch are pure of clock and network; the transport and its sleep are parameters of Send Generation and Send Batch (P4, P11). git spawns only in Run Git, synchronously, with the child's environment given whole as a parameter; it reads no process.env and no clock of its own (P6). cli touches the process only in its entry src/cli.ts: the environment, the working directory, the clock and the output streams reach main() as parameters, and the environment reaches the processor only through Read Registry (P7). language is pure data and pure functions: no clock, no environment, no file system, no child process; node:path is its only Node module; its shell lines are text (P8). contour reads no file, no clock and no environment: it parses the text it is given; the package yaml is imported in Parse Document alone (P9). planner reads no file, no clock and no environment: the cli reads the record and the map and passes which files exist as a function; node:path is its only Node module (P10a). builder reads no file, no clock and no environment: the caller passes the checks, the cards, the profile and the texts of the guard, the locator and the probes; node:path is its only Node module (P10b). primer reads files and spawns git (git's gitOk, the environment a parameter) only in Primer Command, the clock only there through deps.now; Read Runs, Read Story and Render Primer are pure functions of what they are given, no network anywhere (P12a). scout reads no clock, no environment and no network and spawns nothing: Parse Turn, Spend Budget and Seed From Ownership are pure; Cage Path and Run Tool reach the file system only through the ScoutFs parameter (realpath, readFile); elapsed time is a parameter; node:path is its only Node module (P13a). scout-session reaches the model only through the processor's Send Generation and the clock only through deps.now; Run Scout reads the tree through the ScoutFs parameter; Scout Command and Plan From Scout are the scout layer's two node:fs files (git through gitOk and runGit, node:crypto for the sha256 in Scout Command), the environment a parameter (P13b). reviewer's checks (Find Obligations, Check Envelope, Check Guardrails, Plan Mutants, Render Findings) are pure functions of the record, git's outputs and the texts they are given: no file, no clock, no environment, no child process, no Node module (P14a). review-session spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance (the mutant runs, each under its timeout) and git's Run Git; Run Mutants writes only through acceptance's Restore Snapshot; Review Command is the reviewer layer's one node:fs file (the record, the map and scout.json read, the review written), the environment a parameter, no clock and no model call (P14b). debt spawns only through acceptance's Run Acceptance and git's Run Git, reads the deck file, the card's files and the run archive through node:fs, no clock and no model call; the environment is a parameter (P17). scaffold reads the template folders and writes the new project through node:fs (node:url only to find the package root from its own module file), spawns nothing, reads no clock and no environment (P18).
- Node Only: Runtime dependencies: Node 20 built-ins and the package `yaml` (the record reader), nothing else; dev dependencies pinned exactly, no ^ or ~.

Guardrails:
- No Network In Tests: tests/setup.ts makes fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and net.connect throw "network blocked in tests"; only the processor's own transport is mocked.
- No Shell Outside Acceptance: child processes are spawned only by Run Acceptance, the git module (in Run Git alone, P6) and the processor's none; everything else is pure.
- Frozen Tree During Run: while a run is in flight no file outside the cards' targets and .morph/ changes; a changed declared input discards the answer unread.

## Function Session Text

The texts Run Scout adds — budget sentence and budget left, lines not run, the correction after the close, round zero (the task's identifiers in the tree before turn 1).

Behaviour: src/scout/sessionText.ts, pure (Cage Path and the injected fs only). ANSWER_SHAPE = '{"targets": [...], "context_slice": [...], "reasoning": "..."}'. budgetSentence(budgets) = "Your budget: <calls> tool calls, <reads> files read, <chars> characters of tool replies, <rounds> rounds. When the calls, reads or characters run out you get one last turn: send ANSWER in it; an answer refused there gets one correction." budgetLeft(budgets, spent) = "Budget left: <c> calls, <r> file reads, <ch> chars, <ro> rounds.", each max(0, budget − spent). notRun(skipped) = "Not run: " + skipped " | "-joined + ". One action line per turn; equal lines count once." afterClose(problem) = problem + ". No more tools will run: send ANSWER " + ANSWER_SHAPE + " now, every path a file of the tree, the JSON object last." taskClues(question) → at most ROUND0_CLUES (8) strings: the matches of CAMEL /\b[A-Za-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[A-Z][a-z0-9]*)+\b/g, SNAKE /\b[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:_[a-z0-9]+)+\b/g, QUOTED /["`]([^"`\n]+)["`]/g (its group 1) and FILE /\b\w+(?:\/\w+)+\.\w+\b/g, ordered by the match's index (ties: that pattern order); a clue shorter than 3 chars, all digits, or a repeat is dropped. roundZero(question, tree, fs, skip: string[], maxChars) → "" when taskClues is []; else the lines ROUND0_HEADER ("Round zero: the task's identifiers in the tree, found before your first turn (no budget spent):"), then per clue "\"<clue>\": <m> match|matches in <f> file|files", its first ROUND0_HITS (20) hits "<file>:<i>: <line>" (a line over 200 chars: its first 200 + "… (+<rest> chars)"), "… <m − 20> more matches" when more. A hit is a line i (Run Tool's lines of a file) holding the clue as a substring, case-sensitive; files: tree.files in code-unit order, passing over a file that starts with an entry of skip (Run Tool's grepSkip rule: an entry with no "/" is "<entry>/"), refused by Cage Path (file), unreadable or holding "\0". The lines are "\n"-joined while the text stays ≤ maxChars; the first line that does not fit and every later one are left out and "… round zero cut at <maxChars> chars" is appended as the last line.

Steps:
- uses: scout
- produces: Session Texts

Examples (the tests must prove each one):
1. given DEFAULT_BUDGETS; spent {calls 2, reads 1, chars 50000, rounds 3}; spent {31, 12, 120086, 40}; skipped ["LIST b", "GREP x -- src"]; problem "ANSWER rejected: targets: not in the tree (missing, ignored or a directory): src/c.ts"; when budgetSentence; budgetLeft twice; notRun; afterClose; then "Your budget: 30 tool calls, 12 files read, 120000 characters of tool replies, 40 rounds. When the calls, reads or characters run out you get one last turn: send ANSWER in it; an answer refused there gets one correction."; "Budget left: 28 calls, 11 file reads, 70000 chars, 37 rounds."; "Budget left: 0 calls, 0 file reads, 0 chars, 0 rounds."; "Not run: LIST b | GREP x -- src. One action line per turn; equal lines count once."; the problem + ". No more tools will run: send ANSWER {\"targets\": [...], \"context_slice\": [...], \"reasoning\": \"...\"} now, every path a file of the tree, the JSON object last."
2. given the questions "Fix `Exited(` when LimitsUnknown is set in a/run.go.\n"; "Use parseTurn, run_scout and \"the final turn\" in src/scout/runScout.ts; ab_c, `x`, `2026`, LimitsUnknown again"; "AaBb CcDd EeFf GgHh IiJj KkLl MmNn OoPp QqRr"; "Make b twice a.\n"; when taskClues; then ["Exited(", "LimitsUnknown", "a/run.go"]; ["parseTurn", "run_scout", "the final turn", "src/scout/runScout.ts", "runScout", "ab_c", "LimitsUnknown"]; the first 8 ("AaBb" … "OoPp"); []
3. given a real tmp dir: .morph/x.md "LimitsUnknown\n", a/run.go "func (s *S) Exited() bool {\n\treturn s.LimitsUnknown\n}\n", b/doc.md "Exited( here\nExited( " + 250 × "z" + "\n", c/many.txt 22 × "LimitsUnknown\n"; files those four; node fs; skip [".morph", "decks"]; the first question of example 2; when roundZero with maxChars 30000; with 150; roundZero of "Make b twice a.\n"; then ROUND0_HEADER, "\"Exited(\": 3 matches in 2 files", "a/run.go:1: func (s *S) Exited() bool {", "b/doc.md:1: Exited( here", "b/doc.md:2: Exited( " + 192 × "z" + "… (+58 chars)", "\"LimitsUnknown\": 23 matches in 2 files", "a/run.go:2: \treturn s.LimitsUnknown", "c/many.txt:1: LimitsUnknown" … "c/many.txt:19: LimitsUnknown", "… 3 more matches", "\"a/run.go\": 0 matches in 0 files", "\n"-joined (1085 chars); ROUND0_HEADER + "\n\"Exited(\": 3 matches in 2 files\n… round zero cut at 150 chars"; ""
4. given the tree of Run Tool example 7 (Python, Go, TypeScript), node fs, skip [".morph", "decks"]; question "Rename load_config in app/core.py and the Go twin loadConfig; keep `open(path)`.\n"; when taskClues; roundZero with 30000; then ["load_config", "app/core.py", "loadConfig", "open(path)"]; ROUND0_HEADER + "\n\"load_config\": 1 match in 1 file\napp/core.py:1: def load_config(path):\n\"app/core.py\": 0 matches in 0 files\n\"loadConfig\": 2 matches in 2 files\ncmd/main.go:3: func main() { loadConfig() }\nlib/config.ts:1: export function loadConfig(): void {}\n\"open(path)\": 1 match in 1 file\napp/core.py:2: return open(path).read()" (412 chars)
5. given examples.json["Session Text 5"].given; when roundZero with 30000, three skips; then examples.json["Session Text 5"].then

Schema:
string (budgetSentence, budgetLeft, notRun, afterClose, roundZero); string[] (taskClues)
